description: Partial rebuilding of 56 Clabon Mews with altered roof form to provide a roof terrace, lowered lower ground floor, and garage door; retention of the rear lightwell with glazed walk-on rooflight above; kitchen installation within rear room of 24 Cadogan Square; internal alterations to all floor levels including the alteration to rear third floor landing and terrace access; glazed cover, lift overrun and third floor terrace. Provision of condenser units within acoustic enclosures on the rear roof terrace of the Mews at ground floor level; roof terrace at third floor level, within the central lightwell and front lower ground floor lightwell and renewal of services and related refurbishment works throughout the building
site_name: 56 Clabon Mews and, 24 Cadogan Square, LONDON, SW1X 0JP
